# THE GLOBAL

SEMICONDUCTOR MARKET

Over the past three decades, the semiconductor industry has

Chip performance and cost improvements made possible the evolution from

mainframes to PCs in the 1990s, the Web and online services in the 2000s, and the smartphone revolution in the 2010s. Innovation in Al, electric vehicles, and industrial manufacturing will drive continued growth in the chip market through the next decade. By 2030, Al alone is projected to contribute more than $15 trillion to the global economy. Semiconductors have become essential to our modern world, which is why long-term market demand for semiconductors remains strong.
